name: @eliminition/contracts
description: OpenAPI specifications and shared API clients.

scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:ts && npm run codegen:python && npm run codegen:kotlin
scripts.codegen:ts: cross-env JAVA_HOME="C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi/child-safety-v1.yaml -g typescript-fetch -o src/generated
scripts.codegen:python: cross-env JAVA_HOME="C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi/child-safety-v1.yaml -g python -o ../python/src/child_safety_core/models --additional-properties=library=pydantic-v2,packageName=child_safety_core.models
scripts.codegen:kotlin: cross-env JAVA_HOME="C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi/child-safety-v1.yaml -g kotlin -o ../../apps/childSafetyMobile/generated --additional-properties=packageName=com.eliminition.models
